const value = 1;
class A { constructor(read = () => value) { var value = 2; console.log(read(), value); } }
new A();
class B { constructor({ read = () => value } = {}) { var value = 2; console.log(read()); } }
new B();
class Base { constructor(public tag: string) {} }
class C extends Base {
  constructor(public n = 3, read = () => n) { super("c"); var n = 10; console.log(this.n, read(), n, this.tag); }
}
new C();
class D { constructor(public k: number, get = () => helper()) { function helper() { return "inner"; } try { console.log(get()); } catch (e) { console.log((e as Error).constructor.name); } } }
new D(1);
class E { constructor(x: number) { var x: number; console.log(x); } }
new E(5);
